columns.rationale: id has null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 10760 equal to row_count, with purely numeric samples like 232758-232770, so it is cast from VARCHAR to INTEGER and renamed runway_id to reflect it as the publisher's internal runway identifier.
airport_ref has null_rate 0.0 and purely numeric samples (10309, 10366, 1058...), matching the operator's description of an internal integer key, so it is cast from VARCHAR to INTEGER.
airport_ident has null_rate 0.0 with alphanumeric samples like 03N, 07FA, 19AK and is the externally visible key matching the airports table's ident, so it is kept as VARCHAR.
length_ft has null_rate 0.008 and all samples are whole numbers (0.0, 2.0, 20.0...24, 26, 30), so it is cast from DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER and retained nullable for the 86 missing rows.
width_ft has null_rate 0.083 (888 nulls) and samples are all whole numbers (1.0, 10.0, 15.0...), so it is cast to INTEGER and retained nullable.
surface has null_rate 0.023 and 239 distinct non-exhaustive codes such as ASP, ASP-G, ASPH-CONC-F, so it is renamed surface_code per the operator's _code convention and kept as VARCHAR.
lighted has null_rate 0.0 and distinct_values [0.0, 1.0] only, matching a flag for night lighting, so it is cast to BOOLEAN and renamed is_lighted per the is_ convention.
closed has null_rate 0.0 and distinct_values [0.0, 1.0] only, matching a flag for current closure, so it is cast to BOOLEAN and renamed is_closed.
le_ident has null_rate 0.001 (11 nulls) with designator samples like 00, 01C, 01R, and is renamed low_end_ident to spell out the le_ (low end) abbreviation per operator convention.
le_latitude_deg has null_rate 0.221 (2377 nulls) with fractional decimal-degree samples (-62.187801 to 82.5128), so it stays DECIMAL/number and is renamed to spell out le_ as low_end_.
le_longitude_deg has null_rate 0.221 with fractional decimal-degree samples (-179.881256 to 179.338837), so it stays DECIMAL/number and is renamed low_end_longitude_deg.
le_elevation_ft has null_rate 0.276 (2973 nulls) and all samples are whole numbers (-1246.0, -184.0, -127.0...), so it is cast to INTEGER and renamed low_end_elevation_ft.
le_heading_degt has null_rate 0.228 (2457 nulls) and samples include fractional values (0.2, 0.4, 0.7, 1.12), so it stays DECIMAL/number and is renamed to spell out degt as degrees.

le_displaced_threshold_ft has a very high null_rate of 0.884 (9514 nulls) and all samples are whole numbers (1.0, 2.0, 10.0...), so it is cast to INTEGER, renamed low_end_displaced_threshold_ft, and retained sparsely populated since most runway ends have no displaced threshold.
he_ident has null_rate 0.005 (53 nulls) with designator samples like 00, 01L, 04R, and is renamed high_end_ident to spell out the he_ (high end) abbreviation.
he_latitude_deg has null_rate 0.222 (2391 nulls) with fractional decimal-degree samples, so it stays DECIMAL/number and is renamed high_end_latitude_deg.
he_longitude_deg has null_rate 0.222 with fractional decimal-degree samples, so it stays DECIMAL/number and is renamed high_end_longitude_deg.
he_elevation_ft has null_rate 0.276 (2972 nulls) and all samples are whole numbers (-1210.0, -181.0, -135.0...), so it is cast to INTEGER and renamed high_end_elevation_ft.
he_heading_degt has null_rate 0.227 (2444 nulls) with fractional samples (0.1, 0.2, 0.3...), so it stays DECIMAL/number and is renamed to spell out degt as degrees.

he_displaced_threshold_ft has a very high null_rate of 0.900 (9683 nulls) and all samples are whole numbers (10.0, 30.0, 33.0...), so it is cast to INTEGER, renamed high_end_displaced_threshold_ft, and retained sparsely populated.
_airbyte_raw_id is flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and is a capture-tool artifact, so it is dropped.
_airbyte_extracted_at is flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and only records the two extraction timestamps of this sync, so it is dropped.
_airbyte_meta is flagged is_airbyte_metadata true with a single distinct value {}, carrying no business information, so it is dropped.

decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 10760, so bronze contains no exact duplicate rows and no deduplication logic is required.
id (renamed runway_id) has distinct_count 10760 equal to row_count 10760 with null_rate 0.0, so it is the natural one-row-per-runway grain key.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are flagged is_airbyte_metadata true and carry no business meaning, so they are dropped.
Per operator convention to spell out abbreviated column names, the le_ (low end) and he_ (high end) prefixes are renamed to low_end_ and high_end_ across all ten paired columns.
low_end/high_end latitude, longitude, elevation, and heading columns carry null_rate between 0.221 and 0.276, so they are retained as nullable rather than imputed or dropped.

le_displaced_threshold_ft has null_rate 0.884 and he_displaced_threshold_ft has null_rate 0.900, indicating most runway ends have no displaced threshold; both are retained nullable rather than coerced to zero.
length_ft, width_ft, low_end/high_end elevation_ft, and low_end/high_end displaced_threshold_ft samples are all whole numbers (e.g. 0.0, 2.0, 20.0), so they are cast from DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER.
lighted and closed each have distinct_count 2 with distinct_values [0.0, 1.0], so they are cast to BOOLEAN and renamed is_lighted and is_closed per the is_ boolean convention.
surface holds non-exhaustive codes such as ASP, ASP-G, ASPH-CONC-F (239 distinct values), so it is renamed surface_code per the _code naming convention.

purpose: silver_runways cleans the OurAirports runways bronze extract into one row per runway (grain: runway_id), carrying physical runway attributes and the low-end/high-end geometry columns for the airports in the airports extract, for use in airport-infrastructure and runway-capability analysis.
usage: Join on airport_ref or airport_ident to the airports silver table to bring in airport-level context. Consumers must handle nulls explicitly: coordinate, elevation, and heading columns are null for roughly 22-28% of rows, and displaced_threshold columns are null for the great majority of rows since most runway ends have no displaced threshold. surface_code is not drawn from a fixed enumeration and should be normalized by the consumer if grouping by surface type is needed.
limitations: Deduplication was unnecessary (duplicate_row_rate 0.0 across 10760 rows), so no dedupe_keys are set. Geodata (latitude, longitude, elevation, heading) and displaced-threshold columns remain sparsely populated (null rates from 0.001 up to 0.900) and were not imputed. surface_code retains its original 239 distinct unnormalized values since the publisher states the code list is not fixed.
